note: Screening label set used only when the trained classifier (fieldzy_sound_model.pkl) is not installed. When the classifier is present, ITS labels are authoritative and this file is ignored.

classes.label: Machinery / engine
classes.description: Low, steady engine or pump noise close to the field.
classes.recommendedAction: Confirm whether scheduled equipment is running, then photograph or log the source.

classes.label: Animal distress call
classes.recommendedAction: Check the boundary in person or with a camera before treating this as an intrusion.

classes.label: Alarm / buzzer
classes.recommendedAction: Inspect the pump house or shed for a triggered alarm.

classes.label: Insect chorus
classes.recommendedAction: Log as context; pest pressure needs crop scouting evidence.

classes.label: Bird activity
classes.description: Short tonal calls with many transients.
classes.recommendedAction: Note for harvest-window planning; no immediate action.

classes.label: Wind / rain
classes.description: Broadband weather noise with no clear tonal component.
classes.recommendedAction: No field action. Use the weather card for context.

classes.label: Unclassified background
classes.description: Ambient sound without a confident category.
classes.recommendedAction: Record again closer to the source if the sound matters.

classes.label: No usable signal
classes.description: The clip is silent or almost silent.
classes.recommendedAction: Check the microphone and record again.
